payload.evidence: One GET-only local measurement after idle restart. Timings are observations, not a controlled latency benchmark.

cached_live_ui.evidence: Read-only live saved metadata/captions. Browser blocks API writes; no new search, transcript acquisition or model call.

privacy.scope: Exact configured env key/token/contact values in git-visible tracked and untracked working files. Excludes ignored env/state/dependencies; not Git history, encoded values, unknown secrets or OCR.

notes: Broad mocked run passed92/94. Updated one legacy assertion to open intentionally collapsed metadata coverage; fixed Tooltip Escape default cancellation so native dialogs close and restore focus. Corrected affected cases passed.
Actual external providers/models were not invoked by this validation. Backend summary APIs use saved state; read-only live UI checks blocked writes and preserved usage.
App restarted only after checking no active research. Local service endpoints rechecked after restart.
Payload/request reductions do not establish external provider latency improvements.
